contracts_reused: OB-1 OwnedBuf/OwnedBlock allocation, adoption provenance and single release
OB-3 OwnedCtx/RawCtx item ownership at the ASN1_TYPE and duplication boundaries
B1-B17 BIO and application callback reentrancy contract (raw pointers only, no Rust borrow held across a callback)

AGENTS.md section 3 checked extent arithmetic at ASN.1 allocation and BIO read sites

defects.severity: medium (memory safety; invalid ASN1_STRING extent, not reachable from a well-formed parse)
defects.class: AGENTS.md section 2/21 validity-before-reference: ASN1_UNIVERSALSTRING_to_string checked only length % 4 before core::slice::from_raw_parts_mut(data, length as usize); a negative length is congruent to 0 modulo 4 and becomes an enormous slice, which is immediate UB. The authority instead writes one terminator byte at offset zero.
defects.fix: Refuse a negative length before forming the slice, and state the nonnegative-extent precondition in the safety contract. Added the negative-control test asn1::a_print::tests::universalstring_refuses_a_negative_length_without_forming_a_slice.
defects.divergence: For an ASN1_STRING whose length is invalid (negative) the candidate returns 0 instead of performing the authority's one-byte write; AGENTS.md section 17 forbids reproducing undefined behaviour.

defects.severity: low (compatibility and security-relevant state: a reused BN_CTX slot could retain BN_FLG_CONSTTIME)
defects.class: Authority divergence: bn_ctx.c:237 clears BN_FLG_CONSTTIME on every BN_CTX_get, because a temporary returned to the pool may carry a flag set by a previous frame. The crate cleared only the value and sign.
defects.fix: Clear BN_FLG_CONSTTIME after BN_clear on the reused/returned object. Added bn::ctx::tests::ctx_get_clears_a_leaked_consttime_flag.
defects.divergence: None; this restores the authority's observable BN_get_flags result.

retained_obligations: src/asn1/a_digest.rs: the second i2d pass's return is ignored and EVP_Digest reads the sized extent, matching the authority; a short-writing caller encoder leaves uninitialised tail bytes, as in C. Retained for authority parity, not repaired.

src/asn1/a_dup.rs: ASN1_item_dup preserves the authority's leak of the decoded value when a DUP_POST callback fails, and of b when ASN1_item_i2d reports an error after allocating. Resource leak, not UB.
src/asn1/a_i2d_fp.rs: a short second i2d pass leaves uninitialised tail bytes readable by write_all, exactly as the authority's OPENSSL_malloc/write loop. Retained.

src/bn/ctx.rs: BN_CTX and BN_GENCB are Rust Box/Vec owned, so CRYPTO_set_mem_functions does not observe them (documented module boundary), Box allocation aborts rather than returning NULL on OOM, and BN_CTX_get does not model the authority's too_many/err_stack suppression. Compatibility residuals, not memory-safety defects.
src/bn/ctx.rs: BN_GENCB_set(cb, NULL, arg) makes BN_GENCB_call answer 0 instead of calling through the authority's null function pointer; retained as the documented section 17 divergence.
